title: capture-correction input
description: One human correction, the experiment it is about, and the ledger window a proposed check must be replayed over. The check block is a tiny declarative predicate so the human can read what their sentence turned into.

experiment_id.description: The experiment the human is correcting.

correction_note.description: The human's own words: what the agent concluded and what the right conclusion is.

classification.description: Named by the human when known; inferred from the note otherwise.

playbook_target.description: Playbook the correction edits, when it is a try-order fix.

check.description: The proposed verifier check. Required when the classification is verifier_check.

checks_metric.description: Canonical metric the predicate reads; required for a metric predicate.

metric.description: Alias for checks_metric, accepted so a card reads naturally.

band.description: Movement inside this band counts as unmoved.

must_catch.description: Past cases of the same kind the check has to catch; empty means 'every entry the check applies to'.

must_not_flag.description: Experiments that were rightly confirmed; the check must leave them alone.

ledger.description: The window to replay over. Read from ledger/experiments.jsonl; read-only.
